question: How many cultural sites in Ukraine will be damaged as of December 31, 2026, according to UNESCO?

calls.reasoning: Tracker shows 563 as of 29 Sep 2026 (page updated 7 Oct). Trend: ~476 Jan 2025, 501 Jun 2025, 523 Mar 2026, 545 Jul 2026, 560 Sep 23, 563 Sep 29 — 2026 pace ~6/month, accelerated vs 2025 (~2.5/month). About 3 months to year-end; expect 1-3 more batch updates adding ~8-25. Fine print uses last 2026 update, so a no-update risk pins at 563 (small). Upper escape past 660 is negligible. No human market found on Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi.
